import json,sys,cv2,numpy as np
cases=json.load(sys.stdin)
out=[]
detector=cv2.QRCodeDetector()
for case in cases:
    image=cv2.imdecode(np.fromfile(case['path'],dtype=np.uint8),cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
    raw,points,straight=detector.detectAndDecodeBytes(image)
    text=raw.decode('utf-8')
    out.append({'input':case['input'],'decoded_text':text,'detected':points is not None,
                'decoded_utf8_hex':raw.hex(),'passed':text==case['input']})
print(json.dumps({'opencv':cv2.__version__,'cases':out},ensure_ascii=False))
